Category: Very Expensive
Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Type: Iconic Drug

Iconic Drug. PRIMARY EFFECT: lasts 1 month, and a second dose inside that month does nothing and adds no time. While it runs, natural healing can carry the user 10 HP past the maximum their BODY and WILL set, though Speedheal can't reach that extra health; with Enhanced Antibodies installed they heal BODY x 3 HP for each day of rest; and every dose of Speedheal heals 5 more HP. SECONDARY EFFECT (DV21): any HP above their natural maximum is lost, and the user is now addicted to Pseudoembryonic Cell Builder if they weren't. While addicted their BODY drops by 2 unless the Primary Effect is running, and that drop does move their maximum HP and Death Save.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • While addicted, switch on the "Prototype Pseudoembryonic Cell Builder Addiction" effect; switch it off again while the Primary Effect is running, which cancels it.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; the month-long duration, caps, minimums and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Gear).
